title: Segmented choice
responsibility: Offers a labeled group of string-valued choices.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected string, empty by default. Click replaces it. Values outside the options leave all buttons unselected; no fallback is chosen.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.options
inputs.description: Required option strings in display order, serving as both labels and keys. Callers should supply unique strings. Empty renders no buttons.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name of the group.

outputs.name: SegmentedChoice
outputs.description: Buttons with active styling and aria-pressed for the selected value. Selection updates the binding without submitting a form.
